versions.changelog:
No functional changes; documentation has been fully translated from Chinese to English.

- SKILL.md content is now in English for broader accessibility.
- Guidance, examples, and usage instructions remain unchanged.

- Initial release of the custom-skill-request skill.
- Guides users to request custom skill development via email.
- Provides contact information and suggests how to structure requirement details.
- Helps users summarize their needs into a ready-to-send email draft if sufficient context is available.
- Only invoked when user requests exceed current skill capabilities or require custom/private/commercial solutions.
